TEST AND FIX THE SHOWCASE CIRCUIT AS A DRIVEABLE RACE TRACK. This is not a build-only audit. The user has already driven the current track and reports it is barely drivable and that geometry/scenery is all over the place. Treat that feedback as authoritative.

Primary mission: diagnose and correct the actual route geometry and physics-surface continuity in src/graphics/tracks/showcaseCircuit.ts. You may edit App.tsx or StartMenu only if required for testing/fixing track behavior. Do not change M5 vehicle physics equations/tuning/validation code.

Perform a deep static/playability analysis of the full loop. Quantify or reason through: local curvature / minimum corner radius, grade and grade-rate changes, banking transitions, centerline segment spacing, ribbon orientation/twist continuity, road width, edge/runoff continuity, self-intersections, bridge deck clearance, wrong-branch selection at XZ crossovers, surface elevation continuity, normal discontinuities, spawn heading/elevation, and whether an M5 can traverse the loop continuously at sensible racing speeds.

Hard acceptance criteria:
- No sudden track-surface elevation jumps or normal flips along the centerline.
- No ribbon inversion/twisting or sharp Catmull-Rom overshoot that makes corners physically unreasonable.
- Avoid absurdly tight radii for an 16 m-wide M5 circuit; smooth/control-point layout should read as a real GP track.
- Grades and bank transitions must be progressive; remove roller-coaster spikes.
- At the bridge crossover, the active deck selection must be stable for all 4 wheel contact queries, not statefully oscillate based on whichever wheel sampled last.
- Surface lookup must not use a single mutable global elevationHint in a way that can make left/right or front/rear wheels choose different decks at the same frame.
- Off-track/runoff should not create invisible cliffs immediately beside the asphalt unless visually intentional.
- Reset/spawn must put all wheels on a coherent road patch.
- Preserve default plane behavior exactly.

If the current route is fundamentally bad, simplify or redraw the control points rather than trying to save every spectacle feature. DRIVEABILITY WINS. Keep the bridge/tunnel/elevation identity only where it remains coherent.

Produce a concrete patch. Prefer deterministic, testable helper functions/exports where useful. Include exact tests/diagnostics the lead can run, but do not claim you executed them. Required gates remain npm run test:conventions, npm run test:m5-validation:strict, npm run build.
